name: Root

categories.label: Victory points on score track
categories.hint: First to 30 VP wins immediately; each faction scores differently (+1 per enemy building/token removed, crafting VP).

categories.label: Won by dominance card
categories.hint: Activated dominance (needs 10+ VP): rule 3 clearings of its suit, or 2 opposite corners for Bird, at start of Birdsong. Score marker is removed once activated.

categories.label: Vagabond shared win via coalition
categories.hint: 4+ players: Vagabond activates a dominance card, partners with lowest-VP player; wins if that player wins.

tiebreakers.description: If several players reach 30 VP simultaneously, the player whose turn it is wins.

roles.label: Vagabond
roles.winCondition: 30 VP, dominance, or coalition partner wins

endCondition.description: Game ends immediately when a player reaches 30 VP or wins by dominance.

winCondition: Immediate win at 30 victory points, or via an activated dominance card (rule 3 clearings of its suit; Bird: 2 opposite-corner clearings) at the start of your Birdsong. Vagabond may instead win with a coalition partner in 4+ player games.
notes: family: area-majority (race to a target score with asymmetric factions; +1 VP per enemy building/token removed, VP on crafted items). Base game only; Riverfolk, Underworld, Marauder expansions add factions and are not modelled. Dominance cards are removed in 2-player games.
